_meta.purpose: Каталог условных task families offline-этапа B и внешних release-гейтов C. harness-production-plan превращает его в applicability matrix и создаёт только доказанно нужные задачи.
usage: Не копировать этот файл в tasks.json.
Не использовать фиксированный диапазон id; выбирать следующий свободный numeric id.
При persistence выводить stage из phase: B0-B4 -> B, C1-C3 -> C.
Для каждой dimension сначала установить required, already_satisfied, not_applicable или blocked.
Для одной external boundary объединять совместимый SDK constraint, provider/client lifecycle, adapter, DI и protocol tests в одну capability task.
После B2 wiring и применимых B3 cleanup/observability changes создавать одну offline-runtime-lifecycle task; live evaluation остаётся отдельным разрешённым действием.
Logging, health/readiness и telemetry одного process set объединять в одну operability capability, если нет разных owners или rollback boundaries.
Использовать verification pyramid: scoped -> capability -> offline runtime -> bundle -> live; тяжёлый gate повторять только при изменении его входов.
Каждая family задаёт verification_level: scoped, capability, runtime или bundle. Offline runtime имеет runtime; ровно одна final family владеет bundle gate.
Обычный safe-offline Stage-B plan стремится к 7-12 tasks и не превышает 15 до обязательного merge/split pass; live/shared-DB/deploy decision tasks считаются отдельно.

Исходная automatic safe-offline authorization либо одно подтверждение плана покрывает перечисленные dependency/protected-path changes; повторное решение нужно только для scope expansion, conflict/new boundary, live, shared DB, migration side effect или deploy execution.
Для implementation task все paths, source sections и approvals разрешить до persistence; decision/acquisition task может фиксировать exact blocker и owner gap.
Для многорежимного use_skill записывать exact mode только в общем поле skill_mode.

status_contract.required: Target требует слой, current evidence доказывает gap.
status_contract.already_satisfied: Требование уже выполнено и имеет проверяемое evidence.
status_contract.blocked: Обязательное решение, contract, owner или approval отсутствует.

global_invariants: Prototype workflow, prompts, provider/model/params, schemas, retry/timeout, error/terminal/publish semantics не меняются без отдельного approved behavior-change task.
Одна implementation task меняет одну capability; технические части одной external boundary не дробятся по файлам.
Template, production neighbour и release reference сохраняют разные source roles и provenance.
No-op, placeholder и inapplicable tasks не создаются.
make verify дополняется, а не заменяет capability/runtime evidence.
APP scope side-effect-free factory/client не разрешает eager network session; активное соединение открывается request/task-lazy, если authoritative topology явно не требует startup connection.
Stage B нельзя закрыть без real-app offline runtime/lifecycle evidence для production DI и lifespan.
External live/shared-DB/deploy gates принадлежат Stage C и не возвращают зелёный offline Stage B в incomplete.

phase_order.gate: Task-ready checkout, canonical identity and reproducible dependency baseline.
Approved boundary, process topology and DB ownership decisions.
Effective config, boundary capabilities, process wiring and persistence are complete.
One consolidated post-parity cleanup capability and observability are complete before the real-app offline runtime/lifecycle gate.
Offline bundle, container and permanent safety gates.
External release inputs, CI/deploy identity and optional quality evidence.
Separately authorized live/stand and isolated external-state validation.
Operations handoff and explicit release decision.

task_families.applies_if: Target/template review found inconsistent repository, service, package, image, job, queue or schema identity.
prerequisites: Classified token inventory exists.
Domain and external-service tokens are excluded from rename.
Protected-path approvals are recorded.
task_families.title_template: Согласовать canonical identity во всех runtime/build/deploy surfaces
acceptance_template: Один canonical identity matrix подтверждён owner/source docs.
Classified rename выполнен без глобальной замены domain tokens.
Negative search, clean import and applicable build smoke are green.

task_families.applies_if: Clean install/import fails, workspace-wide target/root/lock evidence diverges, or dependency compatibility requires an isolated investigation not owned by one boundary capability.
prerequisites: Dependency policy and owner approvals are known.
Target-specific imports are inventoried.
task_families.title_template: Восстановить воспроизводимый dependency baseline
acceptance_template: Root/project/lock/release differences classified instead of wholesale replacement.
Target-specific dependencies and approved shared pins are preserved.
Lower-bound-only constraints do not admit an unverified next major; exact or bounded compatible range and locked version are evidence-backed.
Clean external install and import smoke pass without warm-environment leakage.

task_families.applies_if: A file/parity boundary must be replaced, or an existing external integration needs exact production proof.
prerequisites: Boundary classification is known.
The boundary is observed in the prototype or listed in the integration passport, and the exact missing contract facts are named.
task_families.title_template: Подготовить production contract для boundary
acceptance_template: The exact data-boundaries technical section is filled from a versioned authoritative contract and sanitized sample, or a greenfield proposal is prepared as a separate design input.
Method/path or exact tool/topic, headers, request, response, errors, schema/versioning, auth, ordering, idempotency, retries, timeout and SLO are explicit.
SDK constraint/lock, transport, local/cluster access, object/session scope, create/close events, startup/readiness criticality, retry owner and failure boundary are explicit.
Observed File IO semantics remain prototype evidence and are not misrepresented as a pre-existing endpoint.
The technical state is DOCUMENTED/MAPPED when facts are complete, or BLOCKED with an exact missing input; no manual status word is required.

task_families.applies_if: Approved source processes do not yet identify every required library, CLI, API, worker, scheduler or init process.
prerequisites: Target architecture owner is known.
task_families.title_template: Утвердить target process topology и entrypoint matrix
acceptance_template: Каждый required process, import target, command, input/output и lifecycle owner записан.
Unobserved API/queue/process is not inferred from prototype shape.
Source, bundled and image execution modes have planned smoke evidence.

task_families.applies_if: A required process reads, writes or migrates a database/schema and ownership or migration policy is unresolved.
prerequisites: Database usage is present in approved topology.
task_families.title_template: Подтвердить DB/schema ownership и migration policy
acceptance_template: Owner, target schema, startup policy and safe isolated/read-only validation mode are explicit.
Shared/foreign database is not reset, stamped or migrated by assumption.

task_families.applies_if: Approved process modes require config not already proven equivalent in source and packaged runtime.
prerequisites: Process topology and config source precedence are approved.
New dependency approval exists when needed.
task_families.title_template: Довести effective runtime config для всех процессов
acceptance_template: Prototype business defaults remain exact; secrets are externalized without real values.
Overlay/source/cwd/resource precedence is tested per applicable process and packaged mode.
Required config fails early without import-time network/DB side effects.

task_families.applies_if: A contract-ready boundary exists and current production adapter/mapping is absent or incorrect.
prerequisites: The matching data-boundaries section is at least MAPPED with exact operation, auth and no material conflict.
The authoritative contract revision is complete and traceable to the integration passport or official source.
Live authorization is separate from execution transport.
task_families.title_template: Реализовать contract-ready boundary capability
acceptance_template: Compatible SDK constraint and locked version, side-effect-free provider lifecycle, adapter mapping, production DI and protocol tests are completed as one capability.
Generated client has spec/version, reproducible generation and regeneration policy when applicable.
Exact method/path or tool/topic, request/response/error bodies, auth/headers, aliases, encoding, absent/null/empty/date/enum mapping and prerequisites are tested.
APP-scoped factory/client object performs no eager network handshake; active session/stream is request/task-lazy unless an authoritative contract marks it startup-critical.
Protocol-faithful test keeps the production client/provider/DI and stubs only the external transport, including handshake, operation and close/error paths required by the SDK.
Terminal error remains error and publish/side effect occurs only in approved success state.
Temporary parity adapter is removed only after mapping parity is green.
Live verification, when applicable, is a separate harness-eval:live task with its own approval gate.

task_families.applies_if: An approved process lacks aggregate registration, entrypoint invocation or terminal-state proof that is not already owned by one boundary capability.
prerequisites: Process topology is approved.
Required config and boundary contracts exist.
task_families.title_template: Подключить и проверить production process
acceptance_template: Import target and documented command start the real process.
Registry/discovery, payload mapping, DI, service call and terminal/publish chain are exercised behaviorally.
Framework success log alone is not accepted as business-success evidence.

task_families.applies_if: Database/migrations are required and source, bundle or target DB revision evidence has a gap.
prerequisites: Database ownership and safe validation mode are approved.
Migration protected-path approval is recorded.
task_families.title_template: Согласовать source, bundle и DB migration state
acceptance_template: Source revisions, bundled revisions, heads and DB current revision are inventoried separately.
Packaging miss, missing source migration and stale/foreign DB are not conflated.
No migration-capable smoke targets unknown/shared DB.

task_families.applies_if: The ds-precheck post-parity cleanup ledger or read-only audit proves applicable residual scaffold/layout drift or dead-code candidates after parity port.
prerequisites: Audit mode is complete.
Exact non-destructive paths are covered by the recorded safe-offline plan; ambiguous deletion paths are human-approved.
Indirect registration allowlist and DB/migration approvals exist.
task_families.title_template: Выполнить consolidated post-parity cleanup
acceptance_template: All applicable approved О-findings are handled as one capability rather than file/finding microtasks.

One post-parity hygiene audit covers stale identities, undocumented routes, manual HTTP where generated clients are required, swallowed errors, unjustified wrappers, startup network providers, pod File IO, .env mutation, bundle resources and unreachable graph code.
Every hygiene finding is classified fix now, retain with reason or defer with owner; findings are not expanded into per-file tasks.
Only approved exact paths move/delete; canonical empty template layers remain.
Static candidate, reachability, human checkpoint and behavior/process smoke all agree.
Contract/golden/build remain green; green tests alone are not proof of dead code.

task_families.applies_if: Approved common/team logging is not already reused or required context/redaction proof is missing.
prerequisites: Process topology is stable.
task_families.title_template: Подключить structured logging без дублирования common middleware
acceptance_template: Common middleware/init is reused before local implementation.
Correlation, component/event, duration, status/error fields propagate across processes.
Secrets and raw prompts/responses are redacted by default.

task_families.applies_if: Approved runtime requires health/readiness/metrics and common/template coverage is absent or unproven.
prerequisites: Exact mechanism/path comes from approved team source.
Process topology is stable.
task_families.title_template: Добавить применимые health/readiness/metrics probes
acceptance_template: Exact approved path/mechanism is used; generic path is not invented.
Probe is cheap and does not call expensive external business systems by default.
Applicable process probe is exercised behaviorally.

task_families.applies_if: Approved topology/team baseline requires telemetry and it is not already satisfied.
prerequisites: Dependency approval exists when needed.
Process topology is stable.
task_families.title_template: Подключить approved telemetry без чувствительных payloads
acceptance_template: Common/team instrumentation is reused where available.
All applicable processes are covered and remain safe without collector/backend.
Only metadata is recorded; secrets and raw inputs/outputs are excluded.

task_families.applies_if: Stage B changes production boundaries, DI, lifespan or API/worker process wiring.
prerequisites: All required B2 boundary capabilities and process wiring are complete.
Applicable consolidated cleanup and observability changes are complete.
Production app factory/export and process entrypoints are known.
External transports can be replaced by protocol-faithful local stubs without replacing production providers or DI.
task_families.title_template: Доказать offline runtime и lifecycle production wiring
acceptance_template: The real exported create_app/app, production DI and real lifespan are exercised; bare FastAPI and test-only composition are forbidden evidence.
Only external transports are stubbed; production client, provider, mapping, DI and process wiring remain real.
A non-startup boundary outage does not kill application startup, connection opens only in the relevant request/task and closes cleanly.
Applicable API and worker paths cover success, unavailable transport and terminal error without network, broker or shared-DB side effects.
Sanitized evidence records exact revision, commands and lifecycle events.

task_families.applies_if: Approved release archetype builds a bundle/artifact and dependency/resource/process inclusion is not proven.
prerequisites: Dependency baseline, process wiring, offline runtime/lifecycle and DB safety gates are green.
Build-file approval is recorded.
task_families.title_template: Собрать и запустить production runtime artifact
acceptance_template: Dynamic modules, generated clients, migrations, prompts and runtime resources have source-to-artifact inventory.
Each applicable artifact process starts and reaches a safe smoke terminal state.
Installed in build environment is not confused with included in artifact.

task_families.applies_if: Approved release archetype requires a container and current build/runtime proof has a gap.
prerequisites: Runtime artifact gate is green or not applicable.
Container/build protected-path approval is recorded.
task_families.title_template: Собрать и проверить target container
acceptance_template: Approved base/runtime pattern and target-specific identity are used.
No secrets or raw runtime artifacts enter build context/image.
Image starts every applicable process; deferred smoke cannot satisfy done.

task_families.applies_if: Approved deployment requires CI/CD or deploy metadata not already proven for target identity.
prerequisites: Deploy identifiers are resolved.
Protected-path approval is recorded.
Build/process gates are green.
task_families.title_template: Настроить CI/CD и deploy metadata для target identity
acceptance_template: Template, production-neighbour and release roles retain separate provenance.
Executable deploy identifiers are real/approved; TODO placeholders cannot pass.
CI runs clean install, import, verify, build and applicable artifact process smoke; live tests remain gated.

task_families.applies_if: Repository/CI lacks persistent guards for its applicable secrets, artifacts, generated outputs or prototype contract.
prerequisites: Repository policies and protected paths are known.
task_families.title_template: Добавить постоянные governance gates
acceptance_template: Only applicable artifact/secret/PII/generated/contract guards are added.
Safe synthetic failures prove each guard blocks without disclosing values.
Existing CI/pre-commit is not weakened; one-off pre-commit review is not used as implementation route.

task_families.applies_if: An approved external quality standard requires a new or stale reference-based golden dataset; prototype parity is not the truth source.
prerequisites: golden-spec intent, accepted count, seed, agent I/O contract and data policy are explicit.
Input references and truth sources are separated, versioned and readable.
A strongest-available oracle and independent verification path can be probed.
task_families.title_template: Синтезировать и выпустить oracle-verified golden dataset
acceptance_template: Pilot proves oracle, realism and verifier isolation before batch scale-up.
Only independently derived hard-gate cases enter the released dataset; ambiguity and disagreement remain in quarantine.
Dataset, audit, quarantine and provenance reports are sanitized and versioned.

task_families.applies_if: A released golden dataset exists and the target agent quality must be measured against it.
prerequisites: Released dataset manifest, audit, hash, compare/equivalence rule and threshold are explicit.
Agent/model/config revision and evaluation data policy are fixed.
task_families.title_template: Оценить agent по released golden dataset
acceptance_template: Only accepted cases are executed; quarantine and expected outputs are not exposed to the agent.
Metrics, slices, repeatability and discrepancies use the declared rules and immutable expected outputs.
Report records dataset and agent revisions and does not rewrite failed golds.

task_families.applies_if: A production boundary or process invariant requires proof against an approved real external system beyond deterministic offline runtime tests.
prerequisites: Eval question, class, threshold and data policy are explicit.
Live flag/secure-stage authorization exists independently of execution transport.
task_families.title_template: Доказать production invariant через integration evaluation
acceptance_template: Same logical inputs and approved mapping are compared with terminal/error/publish invariants.
Repeatability and expected variance are handled where applicable.
Reports are sanitized; raw data, credentials and live outputs are not committed.

task_families.applies_if: Full production readiness is the target outcome.
prerequisites: All required B0-B4 tasks, including offline runtime/lifecycle, are green.
Secure stand and side-effect approvals exist.
task_families.title_template: Доказать clean release и stand readiness
acceptance_template: Clean install, import, verify, build, source/artifact/image processes, DB-safe startup and boundary mapping matrix is complete.
Sanitized stand smoke proves expected node/boundary/terminal/publish path.
Each failing layer becomes a separate corrective task; this task does not mix fixes.
Green evidence produces a compact decision packet for C3; this task does not make or record the owner release decision.

task_families.applies_if: Full production readiness requires an operations handoff and explicit owner release decision; runbook content is added only where applicable.
prerequisites: Required C2 external gates are green or explicitly not applicable.
Real process, boundary and stand failure modes are known where a runbook is applicable.
task_families.title_template: Подготовить operations handoff и получить release decision
acceptance_template: Only applicable observed or approved scenarios are documented; an inapplicable runbook does not remove the release decision gate.
Each scenario has symptoms, safe diagnostics, remediation, escalation owner and evidence source.
Unresolved owner/namespace is a blocker or explicit owned defer, not a silent TODO.
The owner records APPROVE or DEFER, approver/role, date, exact scope and C2 report links; Codex never chooses the release decision.
